input.summary: Ported matrix_rotate.cu to plain SYCL 2020 in migrated/matrix_rotate.dp.cpp. The file has no dpct headers, dpct:: helpers or DPCT_* macros. It uses sycl::queue with an in-order property, sycl::malloc_device/memcpy/free, and a 1-D sycl::nd_range<1> with work-group size 256 and global size rounded up from n/2 layers. Each work-item keeps the original per-layer ring rotation loop unchanged, with a layer < n/2 guard. Compile check: `icpx -fsycl -O2` succeeded with 0 errors and 0 warnings, and the compile was run with add_dpct_include=false, so no dpct headers are needed. Not verified: I have no tool to execute build/candidate, so I have not checked that its output matches the C++ reference bit-for-bit (mode=array, atol=rtol=0). The arithmetic and indexing match the CUDA kernel line by line, and the data is float32 whole numbers, so the output should match, but this is inferred from the source rather than run.
